exact_shadow_report_headlines._provenance_note: Structured fields carrying the exact post-correction headline numbers that the prose rationale field cites. Primary source of truth for headline values; the rationale field is descriptive prose. Enforced byte-for-byte against the committed shadow reports by `test_calibration_fixture_structured_headlines_match_shadow_reports` in `tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/test_l2_reduction_shadow_report.py`. Values refreshed after the controlled predictor-head refit (geometry-mislabel repair + expanded 40-cell corpus) so the structured fields keep mirroring the regenerated shadow reports. Truth-fitted demotion gate: these are WOULD-BE (diagnostic-shadow) values; the deployable headline_post_correction is the pass-through channel and is NOT what these fields mirror.

chosen_factor_provenance.policy: ceil_to_2_decimal_places(per_slug_residual_ratio) for the residual branch (softmax_safe + rmsnorm), 0.88 for the control branch (layernorm) preserved from the layernorm-widening landing. The single-scalar policy was evolved at the R6 user-sanctioned promotion (R47-leftover closure) to a per-slug factor dispatch INSIDE the existing reduction allowlist (NO third L2 allowlist; the two-element L2 correction allowlist scanner invariant is preserved).
chosen_factor_provenance.rationale: The original single-scalar 0.88 was the HARD-3-constrained ceil-to-2dp of the maximum admissible factor 0.8768 across the rmsnorm + softmax_safe cohort (R47 plan-landing). R6 user-sanctioned promotion closes the R47-leftover residual via per-slug factors: layernorm stays at 0.88 (current rel_err 0.13877 within budget), softmax_safe gets factor 0.60 (ceil_to_2dp of 0.5726/0.9583=0.5975; rel_err 0.473 -> 0.004191), rmsnorm gets factor 0.71 (ceil_to_2dp of 0.67948/0.9685=0.7016; rel_err 0.254 -> 0.012008). Exact committed-artifact headlines (superseding pre-commit Codex estimates): R47-only L2 reduction shadow report (`l2_reduction_correction_shadow_report.json::headline_post_correction`) records cross_cell_stddev = 0.19096127604998164 + friendly_l2_geomean_rel_err = 0.0380224231306785. Composed R47+R48 high-footprint shadow report (`l2_high_footprint_correction_shadow_report.json::headline_post_correction`) records cross_cell_stddev = 0.25429915989801619 + friendly_l2_geomean_rel_err = 0.021155318953822142. Both stddev values are inside the widened band [0.10, 0.30] and both friendly_l2_geomean values are below HARD-1 0.15. Per-cell L2 budget: ALL cells pass (large IMPROVEMENT for residual-branch cells, no regression elsewhere). Pre-commit Codex estimate values previously quoted in this rationale field (cross_cell_stddev ~0.243, friendly_l2 ~0.028) were back-of-envelope estimates from the R6 user-sanctioned promotion analysis; they are superseded by the exact committed-artifact values above per BL-20260514 (nested-provenance-systemic-staleness-not-just-top-level).

combination_method.justification: Geometric mean preserves multiplicative consistency across all admitted cells; minimum-MSE on three points would not robustly generalize.
combination_method.name: geometric_mean_of_residual_ratios

correction_factor_status_note: DEMOTED to diagnostic-only by the truth-fitted correction-factor gate: these per-slug factors were derived from the SAME cells' NCU truth, so they must not multiply a deployable prediction. The cache_predictor apply helpers no-op on the deployable value for this family and record the would-be corrected value under diagnostics with this status token. A future slug-disjoint re-derivation (calibration-split slugs disjoint from every scored cell) may flip the status to slug_disjoint_calibrated in code+fixture lockstep.

hard_3_constraint_analysis.analysis_provenance_note: This block records the historical single-scalar constraint analysis that was used at the layernorm-widening landing (all 3 allowlist slugs at factor 0.88). It documents WHY the HARD-3 upper bound widened from the original 0.15 to the user-sanctioned 0.30 and why the single-scalar 0.88 remained admissible under the wider band. The CURRENT per-slug-dispatch sample stddev (which differs because softmax_safe + rmsnorm now use residual-branch factors 0.60 and 0.71 instead of the scalar 0.88) is recorded in `post_correction_simulation.hard_targets.cross_cell_stddev_post` and the production helper output is enforced by `test_post_correction_simulation_matches_production_helper`.
hard_3_constraint_analysis.constraint: 0.10 <= cross_cell_stddev <= 0.30 (plan DEC-13 widening of the cross_cell_stddev bound; the L2 reduction allowlist's layernorm widening composes with the L2 high-footprint correction)
hard_3_constraint_analysis.constraint_evolution_note: At the original R47 plan-landing the constraint upper bound was 0.15. It widened to 0.30 per DEC-13 to admit the L2 high-footprint correction whose accurate factors structurally widen the prediction distribution. The layernorm widening at factor 0.88 leaves cross_cell_stddev at ~0.2571 (computed from committed shadow-report rows by replacing the layernorm L2 post-point with 0.974609375 * 0.88 = 0.85765625), well inside the widened band.
hard_3_constraint_analysis.production_stddev_formula: statistics.stdev(predicted_l2_hit_rate values across admitted L2-scalar cells); see tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/compute_variance_trajectory.py:355
hard_3_constraint_analysis.rationale_for_constraint_binding: The historical maximum_admissible_factor 0.8768 was bisect-found at the original HARD-3 0.15 ceiling. Under the widened HARD-3 0.30 ceiling, the upper-bound is still respected at factor 0.88 (post-widening sample stddev 0.2571 < 0.30). The lower-bound 0.10 is preserved (the predictor's prediction distribution does NOT collapse to a single point under the layernorm widening). The choice to retain factor 0.88 for the control branch (NOT to re-bisect under the wider constraint) follows the layernorm-widening positive-arm specification 'with the existing factor 0.88'.

layernorm_fwd_bf16_sm80.notes: Layernorm stays at the control-branch factor 0.88; the layernorm-widening landing already calibrated this cell to within the per-cell budget.

hard_targets.post_simulation_provenance: Headline `friendly_l2_geomean_post` and `cross_cell_stddev_post` reflect the L2 reduction correction surface applied IN ISOLATION (R47 reduction allowlist + per-slug factor dispatch only, NO R48 L2 high-footprint correction composed). The parity is enforced by `tools/sm_86_predictor_accuracy_recovery_v2/test_l2_reduction_shadow_report.py::test_post_correction_simulation_matches_production_helper`.

purpose: Calibration provenance for _L2_REDUCTION_KERNEL_CORRECTION_FACTORS (per-slug factor dispatch dict) + _L2_REDUCTION_KERNEL_SLUG_ALLOWLIST in workloads/simbench_bw/cache_predictor.py. The backward-compat scalar _L2_REDUCTION_KERNEL_CORRECTION_FACTOR points at the layernorm control-branch factor (0.88) and is the documented `chosen_factor` field; new code paths read the per-slug dispatch dict via `chosen_factors`.
reproducibility_recipe: 1. Read all three bundles named in input_bundles[]; verify bundle_sha256 matches the recorded value. 2. For each bundle, extract predicted_hit_rate as point_pre_class_l2. 3. Read diagnostic_sidecar_path; verify diagnostic_sidecar_sha256. For each allowlist slug, extract cells[i].ncu_truth_l2_fraction as truth_l2. 4. Compute residual_ratio = truth_l2 / point_pre_class_l2 for each slug. 5. unconstrained_calibrated_factor = exp(mean(log(residual_ratio))). 6. The recorded `hard_3_constraint_analysis.maximum_admissible_factor` = 0.8768 is the HISTORICAL original-HARD-3-0.15-ceiling bisect-found maximum (NOT a widened-band maximum; see schema_invariants[3] for the historical-metadata framing). To reproduce that historical value: simulate stddev sweep under the ORIGINAL HARD-3 band [0.10, 0.15]; for factor in [0.0, 1.0], compute post-correction predicted_l2_hit_rate values for all admitted L2-scalar cells; statistics.stdev of those values must satisfy 0.10 <= s <= 0.15; the largest factor at which s == 0.15 is the historical maximum_admissible_factor = 0.8768. The HARD-3 upper bound widened to 0.30 per DEC-13 (recorded in goal-tracker Plan Evolution Log row 0); the fixture intentionally retains the historical 0.8768 value because the runtime constraint is enforced by `post_correction_simulation.hard_targets.hard_3_cross_cell_stddev_in_bound` against the widened band (NOT by re-bisecting `maximum_admissible_factor` against the widened band). 7. chosen_factor (control-branch / backward-compat scalar) = 0.88 (held constant per the layernorm-widening positive arm specification 'with the existing factor 0.88'; intentionally EXCEEDS the historical original-ceiling 0.8768 by ~0.003 because under the widened band the stddev simulation at 0.88 sits at 0.2571 < 0.30, well inside the widened band). 8. Per-slug chosen_factors: layernorm = 0.88 (control branch); softmax_safe = ceil_to_2dp(truth_l2 / point_pre_class_l2) = ceil_to_2dp(0.5726/0.9583) = ceil_to_2dp(0.5975) = 0.60; rmsnorm = ceil_to_2dp(0.67948/0.9685) = ceil_to_2dp(0.7016) = 0.71 (residual-branch under-correction policy: ceil to 2 decimal places of the empirical residual ratio, leaving a small under-correction margin).
schema_invariants: All input_bundles entries reference bundles that exist on disk under data/local_labels/sweeps/.
bundle_sha256 values are SHA-256 hex digests of the bundle JSON files at the recorded paths.
unconstrained_calibrated_factor is in (0, 1] (a multiplicative correction; must not exceed 1.0 to qualify as an over-prediction correction).

chosen_factor is in (0, 1]. NOTE: chosen_factor is NOT constrained by hard_3_constraint_analysis.maximum_admissible_factor at runtime; that field is historical metadata recording the bisect-found maximum under the ORIGINAL HARD-3 0.15 ceiling (= 0.8768). The HARD-3 upper bound widened to 0.30 per DEC-13, and the current chosen_factor 0.88 intentionally EXCEEDS the historical original-ceiling maximum by ~0.003 (see hard_3_constraint_analysis.constraint_evolution_note and hard_3_constraint_analysis.rationale_for_constraint_binding).
Current admissibility of chosen_factor under the widened HARD-3 band [0.10, 0.30] is governed by post_correction_simulation.hard_targets.hard_3_cross_cell_stddev_in_bound, which MUST be true.
